name: GlobalVariable
summary: This EA is a utility demonstration of MQL5 global variable functions (GlobalVariableSet, GlobalVariableGet, GlobalVariableCheck). It creates a client-side global variable with a calculated random value on init and updates it on deinit, with no trading logic whatsoever.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个MQL5全局变量功能的工具演示，展示了GlobalVariableSet、GlobalVariableGet、GlobalVariableCheck的用法。它在初始化时创建全局变量并存入随机计算值，在反初始化时更新该值，没有任何交易逻辑。
strategy_analysis: 该EA不具备任何交易策略，它纯粹是一个展示MQL5全局变量操作的示例工具。策略概念上，它演示了如何在终端全局变量池中创建、检查和读取变量。入场条件无，因为它不执行任何交易操作；出场条件同样不存在。仓位管理和资金管理完全缺失，因为该EA不涉及任何订单或头寸。核心逻辑是：初始化时检查全局变量是否存在，不存在则通过MathRand计算随机值并创建，存在则读取已有值；反初始化时重新计算值并更新全局变量。变量命名采用前缀加魔数的方式（main_id_1010458），以确保唯一性。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA has no trading strategy at all; it is purely a demonstration tool for MQL5 global variable operations. In terms of strategy concept, it illustrates how to create, check, and read variables in the terminal's global variable pool. There are no entry conditions since it does not execute any trading operations, and likewise no exit conditions exist. Position sizing and money management are completely absent because the EA does not involve any orders or positions. The core logic is: on initialization, it checks if the global variable exists; if not, it calculates a random value via MathRand and creates it; if it exists, it reads the existing value. On deinitialization, it recalculates the value and updates the global variable. Variable naming uses a prefix plus magic number pattern (main_id_1010458) to ensure uniqueness.

parameters.name: strGlobalId
parameters.description: 全局变量的名称前缀标识符

parameters.name: magic
parameters.description: 魔数，用于构造全局变量的唯一名称后缀
parameters.description_en: Magic number, suffix for unique global variable names

pros: 清晰演示了MQL5全局变量的创建、检查和读取操作流程
使用魔数后缀确保全局变量名称唯一性，避免冲突
代码结构简洁明了，包含错误处理和错误码输出
OnInit和OnDeinit中分别展示了创建和更新全局变量的不同场景
pros_en: Clearly demonstrates the MQL5 global variable creation, checking, and reading workflow
Uses magic number suffix to ensure global variable name uniqueness and avoid conflicts
Clean and straightforward code structure with error handling and error code output
OnInit and OnDeinit show different scenarios for creating and updating global variables respectively
cons: 没有实际的交易功能，仅是一个API用法示例
OnDeinit中的逻辑与OnInit高度重复，缺少代码复用
全局变量值使用MathRand随机生成，没有实际业务意义
缺少GlobalVariableDel清理逻辑，可能遗留无用全局变量
cons_en: No actual trading functionality; it is merely an API usage example
OnDeinit logic heavily duplicates OnInit logic with no code reuse
Global variable value is randomly generated via MathRand with no practical business meaning
Missing GlobalVariableDel cleanup logic, potentially leaving orphaned global variables
improvements: 在OnDeinit中添加GlobalVariableDel清理逻辑，避免遗留无用全局变量
将OnInit和OnDeinit中重复的全局变量操作逻辑抽取为公共函数
增加GlobalVariableTemp临时变量的演示，扩展示例覆盖范围
improvements_en: Add GlobalVariableDel cleanup logic in OnDeinit to avoid leaving orphaned global variables
Extract duplicated global variable operation logic from OnInit and OnDeinit into a shared function
Add demonstration of GlobalVariableTemp for temporary variables to expand example coverage

risk_points: 不清理全局变量可能导致终端全局变量池积累废弃数据
全局变量值未做范围校验，但因其为演示工具，实际风险极低
risk_points_en: Not cleaning up global variables may lead to accumulation of obsolete data in the terminal's global variable pool
No range validation on global variable values, but actual risk is extremely low since this is a demo tool

summary_en: This EA is a utility demonstration of MQL5 global variable functions (GlobalVariableSet, GlobalVariableGet, GlobalVariableCheck). It creates a client-side global variable with a calculated random value on init and updates it on deinit, with no trading logic whatsoever.
